message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code loads data via local calls to loadData.loadDataset and loadSCM.loadSCM with no remote URL fetching, checksum verification, or source authentication visible in the snippet.
No detected label flipping detection: No code inspects or validates label distributions, checks labels against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms to guard against poisoned training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads models and data (e.g., via loadClassifier, loadCausalModel, and pickle imports) but performs no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision checks on any loaded serialized artifacts.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) are imported or used in any part of the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation mechanism, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: There are no input shape/range checks, schema validation, or malformed-input rejection visible in the inference data-flow path; inputs are passed directly to model and SCM loading functions.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or calibrated threshold checks on model outputs are present in the visible inference code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses tabular/causal ML models (sklearn, GPy, MLP), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
